Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was driving through an intersection in League City on a green light, heading east. I had been on that road for a
few minutes and traffic was moderate.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not until the last moment. A vehicle came from my right side and entered the intersection. I braked and turned
slightly, but it struck the driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you able to stop completely before impact?
A: No. I had slowed down but didn't have time to stop fully.
Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they didn't. The seatbelt held me in place, but I was jolted hard against the seat.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene or did you stay inside?
A: I got out after a minute or two. I was shaky and my neck felt stiff right away.
Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?
A: Yes. My neck is sore and has limited movement, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for long periods.
I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for these symptoms?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and was told I had neck and back strain. I've been referred to a
physical therapist and I have a follow-up scheduled.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?
A: Only that I'm trying to keep up with my appointments and I'm willing to provide my medical records.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
